feature: Crypto agency marketing landing page — conversion-focused, trust-building, responsive design for desktop/tablet/mobile.
screens: Hero — value prop, CTA, subtle animated token grid
Services — cards for Strategy, Tokenomics, Smart Contracts, Launch & Growth
Case Studies — project cards with metrics, filter by service
How We Work — 3-step process with timeline and CTA
Team & Trust — founder bios, logos, certifications, partners
Pricing / Packages — summary cards + contact form CTA
Contact — lead gen form, calendar scheduler CTA, FAQ accordion
Footer — legal links, social links, newsletter signup
components: Top Nav: logo (SVG), primary CTAs (Contact, Get Audit), hamburger for mobile; sticky with 8px shadow on scroll
Hero Module: headline (H1), 3 line supporting copy, primary CTA (filled), secondary CTA (ghost), animated crypto motif (SVG token grid) — tokens decorative aria-hidden
Services Grid: 3–4 cards, title, 2–3 bullets, micro-illustration (svg), ‘Learn more’ link
Case Card: image thumbnail, metric badge (e.g., +250% TVL), short outcome, tech stack pill list
Process Stepper: numbered steps, horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile, progress indicator
Trust Strip: partner logos (lazy loaded, grayscale), testimonials carousel (aria-live)
Pricing Cards: price label, included items checklist, primary action opens contact modal
Contact Form: name, company, email, budget (select), message, file upload (optional), reCAPTCHA fallback
Modal: contact/quote with success/validation states, keyboard and focus trap
Accordion (FAQ): accessible, single-expand by default, keyboard navigable
Footer: sitemap, legal, newsletter input with inline validation
interactions: Hero CTA opens contact modal (focus to first input)
Primary nav: sticky transition on scroll (0→8px shadow, height 72px→56px)
Case study filters: client-side filter with smooth height animation and aria-live region announcing results count
Services card hover: elevate 8px, shadow, reveal CTA; on touch show persistent expanded state
Testimonials carousel: automatic 6s, pause on hover/focus, accessible controls with aria-labels
Form validation: inline validation on blur, summary error at top if submit fails, success state replaces form with message and CTA to book call
Lazy-loading images and partner logos with low-res placeholder (blur-up)
Reduced motion support: respect prefers-reduced-motion, disable non-essential motion
Keyboard navigation: all interactive elements focusable, visible focus ring (3px), skip-to-content link
states: Hero CTA: idle, hover, pressed, loading (spinner, disable), success (open modal)
Form: idle, validating, error per-field, error-summary, submitting (disabled), success
Case Cards: default, hover/active, filtered-hidden (aria-hidden true)
Modal: closed, open, submitting, success, error
responsive: Mobile-first. Breakpoints: small ≤640px (stacked single-column), medium 641–1024px (two-column for hero/services), large ≥1025px (three+ columns where applicable). Navigation: full nav on ≥1025px, collapsed hamburger below. Hero: headline 28px mobile → 40px desktop; token motif switches from decorative grid (desktop) to simplified badge row (mobile). Services grid: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop. Ensure no horizontal scroll; content padding: mobile 16px, tablet 24px, desktop 48px. Touch targets ≥44×44px, 8px min spacing between interactive elements.
design_system:
Proposed tokens (if no existing system):
- Colors: primary #0B63FF (accessible), primary-700 #0849B8, neutral-900 #0B1723, neutral-600 #586675, success #00C48C, accent-gradient linear-gradient(135deg,#0B63FF 0%,#7C4DFF 100%)
- Backgrounds: surface #FFFFFF, surface-2 #F7FAFC
- Typography: Inter (variable) — H1 40/44, H2 28/32, H3 20/24, body 16/24; weight: 700/600/400. Base font-size 16px
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64
- Elevation: none, 8dp, 16dp (shadows specified in CSS tokens)
- Iconography: 24px/16px system, SVGs optimized, aria-hidden true if decorative
- Motion: reveal 180ms ease-out, stagger 60ms, reduced-motion: none
- Accessibility: WCAG AA contrast minimum, focus ring 3px primary with 12px offset, all images have alt or aria-hidden
api_needs: Contact form POST /api/leads (name,email,company,budget,message,utm) — returns 201 + lead id
Request case study data GET /api/case-studies?filter=service — returns list with metrics and image URLs
Availability: optional Calendar scheduling integration endpoint (e.g., /api/schedule)
acceptance_criteria: Hero visible within first viewport on desktop and mobile without layout shift (CLS <0.1)
Primary CTA opens modal and focuses first input; modal traps focus and is keyboard closable (Esc)
All images lazy-load with low-res placeholders; partner logos grayscale by default and have alt text
Forms validate inline and show error summary; successful submit returns 201 and displays success message
Navigation accessible: skip-to-content link present, all interactive elements keyboard-focusable with visible focus ring
Responsive behavior: no horizontal scroll at all breakpoints; layout matches column rules; touch targets ≥44×44px
Prefers-reduced-motion respected: no non-essential animations when set
ARIA: carousel and accordion announce state changes via aria-live where applicable
